notes: The verse opens the apodosis of the frame begun at 1SA.3.2, and rule 45 puts that on the waw that opens it rather than marking it added under rule 55.
הִנֵּה is the verbless clause's predicate and takes the construction-supplied copula, while its 1cs suffix is the subject and takes I (rules 18, 20).
